sents.en: Pyramids have a point on top.
A flat bottom is where they stop.
Triangles make each leaning face.
Faces stretch out wide at the base.
Look around for this shape's look.
Search for pyramids in this book.
Ben sees bright stacks of fruit to eat.
sents.ko: 벤이 먹음직한 과일이 환하게 쌓인 걸 봐요.

sents.en: Built like pyramids, nice and neat.
Pyramid roofs block rain and snow.
sents.ko: 피라미드 모양 지붕은 비와 눈을 막아 줘요.

sents.en: They stay attached as strong winds blow.
Jill peeks through this pyramid's door.
She finds toys camping on its floor.
Ben spots pyramids with burning tips.
sents.ko: 벤이 끝에 불이 붙은 피라미드를 발견해요.

sents.en: Each changes shape as it melts and drips.
This glass pyramid weighs a lot.
It helps keep papers in one spot.
Jill climbs this pyramid in a crawl.
The pyramid top gets very small.
Ben's project is on stars and space.
sents.ko: 벤의 과제는 별과 우주에 대한 거예요.

sents.en: He wins the trophy for first place!
Pyramids aren't just in this book.
sents.ko: 피라미드는 이 책 안에만 있는 게 아니에요.

sents.en: They're all around you.
Take a look!
Ah! Now we know what pyramids look like.
sents.ko: 아! 이제 피라미드가 어떻게 생겼는지 알겠어요.

sents.en: They're very pointy and look like a triangle.
Can you find them?
Try to find some pyramids today, if you can!
I'll see you next time!
